subject.title: fix: WebChat duplicates external reply events

question: Does the Gateway guarantee that `<sessionKey, agentId, runId, state, seq>` identifies a replayed chat frame rather than a distinct user-visible delivery for every event path this UI consumes?
rationale: The branch is intentionally changing message-consumption semantics; source and test evidence supports the target race, but accepting a duplicate-suppression key requires maintainer confirmation of the upstream event contract.

options.title: Verify and land the bounded dedupe
